goal: Projected risk is the highest of declared risk, the scope floor and the floor of the actual changed paths and only strengthens Review, and hard no-touch paths (authority state, credential-type files, CI and release config, plus repository additions in docs/agents/no-touch.json) refuse single-task settlement, batch integration and TaskIntent validation (Spec branch-boundary-r2 D21, D22).

acceptance.assertion: A task declared routine whose actual diff touches a material floor path projects material and requires Review without opening any gate, and a task declared material whose diff touches no floor path still projects material.

A single-task settlement whose diff changes .imm/state/x, .env, a .pem file, .github/workflows/ci.yml or .changeset/config.json refuses with no_touch_path_changed naming the path, and a diff changing only .changeset/feature.md is not refused.
A batch child whose rebuilt commit changes a no-touch path does not advance the Parent branch and is parked with no_touch_path_changed.

A path added in docs/agents/no-touch.json is refused like a default, the declaration cannot remove a default, a malformed declaration is rejected naming the field, changing the declaration itself raises risk to critical, and intent validate rejects a TaskIntent whose scope_hint names a no-touch path.
